entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
The Acting Prime Minister David Seymour has announced new guidelines issued by Land Information New Zealand to international investors, particularly in the supermarket sector | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1
 
He says the government has recently released specialised guidance for supermarkets, which "roll out the red carpet for those who would like to establish a supermarket competitor in New Zealand."
 
"We will issue them a standing consent so that they can buy as many sections of land as they may need to establish a full network of supermarkets," he says.
 
Read more: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/political
